fee_notes: Royalty: 5% of Gross Receipts or $100/week minimum (starting year 2). Marketing Fee: greater of $75/week or 1% of Gross Receipts. Local Marketing Program required 6 months at $250/month, then optional at $400-600/month. Annual local marketing spend minimum: $12,000/year (reduced to $6,000 with dedicated marketing staff or 2-person family operation). Annual conference fee: currently $575, capped at 10% annual increase.
raw_excerpt: Royalty: The greater of 5% of Gross Receipts or the Minimum Performance Requirement, Monthly. Starting in the second calendar year after the opening date, you must pay us a minimum weekly royalty payment in an amount equal to the greater of (i) 5% of your Gross Receipts, or (ii) $100 per week. General Marketing Fee: The greater of $75 or 1% of Gross Receipts, Weekly.
